newsitem.title: USA: Ben & Jerry's supplier files for Chap 11.
newsitem.headline: Ben & Jerry's supplier files for Chap 11.

text.p: A company created by Ben & Jerry's Homemade Inc founder Ben Cohen to harvest nuts from the Amazon rainforest has filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, a company official said Monday.

Community Products Inc, which supplies the crunch for Ben & Jerry's Rainforest Crunch ice cream, filed for bankruptcy protection in a U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Vermont on April 28, Chief Executive Mark Sherman told Reuters.

"Over the years, which was no secret, we had losses," Sherman said. "We had a line of credit that came due from our bank and we didn't have the cash to pay it. We had no choice but to file for reorganization."
Losses totaled about $300,000 in 1996 and total debts have risen to around $1 million, he said.
"This reorganization will enable us to pull together a plan that will allow us to go into the future," Sherman said.
